annotations.title: 2027 Medicare drug plans for a county

description: Every 2027 Medicare plan with drug coverage CMS lists for a county: stand-alone drug plans (with Original Medicare) and Medicare Advantage plans, each with company, monthly premium, change from 2026, drug deductible and, for stand-alone plans, the premium with Extra Help. Give a ZIP code, or a state and county. From CMS's 2027 plan file. It does not say which plan covers which drug (the county page it links checks that against CMS's 2027 drug lists) and it is not a recommendation.

county.description: County name, e.g. "Cook County". Needed with state, or to pick one county when a ZIP crosses county lines.
